caption: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King rebuilds the iconic "You shall not pass" moment on the bridge of Khazad-dûm. The model captures the dramatic scale of the bridge and the hero's defiance, though the hero's resolve is about to be tested by a very different kind of heat.
